compiler_snapshot.note: Exact compiler/runtime/source/script snapshot; apply on this v0.4 base. Pinned competitor sources are separately hashed in manifest.json.

protocol.timed_region: fresh process launch through exit; includes runtime initialization/JIT/source compilation and energy output; excludes ahead-of-time builds
protocol.source_metric: comments removed, whitespace runs collapsed, UTF-8, gzip level 1 with mtime=0; locally specified metric, not guaranteed byte-identical to CLBG gz
protocol.source_scope: Mech .mec source includes all initialization, simulation, energy math, and explicit energy export; generic runtime/compiler/CLI excluded. Other languages use complete pinned submissions.
protocol.c_configurations: GCC and LLVM, native O3 and fast-math/unrolling/LTO for each C/C++ source
protocol.aot_backport_source: iros-workshop-benchmarks; scalar AOT commit b10593b75ec8b9283ae33e4ac330c00dda9957d7; autonomous f64/SIMD extension in this worktree
